mapper.select: SELECT biz16_fund_nm AS fund_name , biz16_fund_fee AS fund_fee , biz16_date AS cont_date , biz16_fund_start_date AS fund_start_date , biz16_note AS note , biz11_cont_corp_nm AS cont_corp_name , biz11_address AS address , biz11_ceo AS ceo FROM biz16_each_contract LEFT OUTER JOIN biz11_cont_history ON biz11_cont_corp_id = biz16_cont_corp_id AND biz11_reg_date = ( SELECT MAX(h.biz11_reg_date) FROM biz11_cont_history h WHERE h.biz11_cont_corp_id = biz16_cont_corp_id AND h.biz11_reg_date <= f_today() ) WHERE biz16_each_contract_id = #{contractId} AND biz16_company_id = #{companyId} LIMIT 1
